result.note: Mostly political analysis and unbudgeted pledges; one question tests the youth pledges from the August 2026 Independence Day address, skipping the BJP social-media reshuffle as party affairs.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the youth-focused pledges in Prime Minister Modi's Independence Day address of August 2026:
items: It pledged AI training for 100 million young people within a year.
It announced a talent hunt to groom children for a 2036 Olympics that India wants to host.
The pledges were made without a stated budget or launch date.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The AI training pledge covered 10 million young people within a year, not 100 million. The address also promised free online exam coaching, though much of the package scales programmes already running and adds no new vacancies.
questions.source: pledging free online exam coaching, AI training for 10 million young people within a year, and a talent hunt grooming children for a 2036 Olympics India wants to host.
